liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (6 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer ranks Jerry's solo in this song among the best moments in the band's history; First played in 19 years, since April 26, 1970 [3][13][14][16][17][20][24]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the China Cat solid within a jamming show; Jerry plays searching stabs in the transition from China Cat into I Know You Rider [14][16]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Phil left mid-song, apparently over a broken strap; the band improvised until he returned around 6:48 and Jerry sang the closing verse [15]
- **I Need a Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer says the Miracle into Death Don't combination really begins the stunning stretch [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **in Bird Song through 5:17 Drums**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy**: back after 1395 archived shows (7132 days) [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-09-29.dsbd.walker-scotton.miller.81705.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1989-09-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81704.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 3/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard sounds really good [22]
- **gd1989-09-29.151621.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd89-09-29.ultramatrix.braverman.7282.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer drove from Colorado with a roommate for this run and sprinted down the lawn at the opening notes of Death Don't [13]
- Word of the show spread to the East Coast, with Death Don't as the headline [17]
- A power outage of roughly five minutes followed Blow Away [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-09-29.dsbd.walker-scotton.miller.81705.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat D [1]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Let The Good Times Roll and 8:45 in Bird Song through 5:17 Drums are patched from a soundboard cassette master [1]
- **gd1989-09-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81704.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [2]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; a second soundboard cassette master patched the tape flip [2]
- **gd1989-09-29.151621.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  September 22, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [3]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; a Healy-mix soundboard without ambient mics, one of few from 1989, made complete from multiple masters [3]
- **gd89-09-29.ultramatrix.braverman.7282.sbeok.shnf**: source: Ultramatrix: Master Cassette> DAT> CD> SHN> Peak> WAV> SHN [5]. Also: Ultramatrix chain: master cassette to DAT to CD to SHN; possibly a later cassette generation; retracked and normalized by Peter Braverman [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1989-09-29 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-09-29-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [26]
